answer: The zenith multiplier is published, charged in reef, and ripple lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 12 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 614 identities would post 3581 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
